urubu.definition:
n. The black vulture (Catharista atrata). It ranges from the
   Southern United States to South America. See Vulture.
urubu.translation: n. (从阿根廷到美国南部一带产的)黑秃鹫,食腐肉的乌鸦

uruguay.definition: n. a South American republic on the southeast coast of South America; achieved independence from Brazil in 1825
uruguay.translation:
n. 乌拉圭
[经] 乌拉圭

uruguay river.translation: [网络] 乌拉圭河；界河乌拉圭河

uruguayan.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Uruguay
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Uruguay or its people
